about: Hand-authored contract for which records of its source run an analysis read (source-snapshot.json). It states the INTENDED answers and is never regenerated from an engine: the record count, size, and SHA-256 of a generations.jsonl's bytes (hashes computed with the system shasum); a source run's status; and each comparison of an analysis's stamp with its run as it stands, with the sentence a reader is told. Two suites read it: Server/tests/test_source_snapshot.py and Tests/ExperimentKitTests/SourceSnapshotTests.swift.

describe.label: two records with a final newline
CRLF, a blank line, a whitespace-only line, no final newline

status.label: a run that completed without a status file
a run with neither a status file nor a report
a completed status but no report
a report beside a checkpoint that was never settled (continued before parks were settled): the records are final
a report beside an unsettled inProgress status
a report beside a failure record
a status that is not a string
a continuation that completed and settled the park

verdicts.label: an analysis of the completed run, unchanged since
a checkpoint's analysis, after the run was continued to completion

expected.sentence: This analysis read run R while it was paused at a checkpoint, with 4 records, and the run now holds 8. Re-analyze the run for effects over all its records.

verdicts.label: a checkpoint's analysis while the run is still parked

expected.sentence: This analysis read run R while it was paused at a checkpoint, with 4 records. Re-analyze the run for effects over all its records.

verdicts.label: a failed run's analysis, the run not readable now (a remote page has only the stamp)

expected.sentence: This analysis read run R while it was marked failed, with 3 records. Re-analyze the run for effects over all its records.

verdicts.label: a status this contract does not name

expected.sentence: This analysis read run R while it was not complete (status: parked-elsewhere), with 2 records. Re-analyze the run for effects over all its records.

verdicts.label: a completed run whose records changed after its analysis

expected.sentence: This analysis read 8 records of run R, and the run's records have changed since (it now holds 9). Re-analyze the run for effects over its current records.

verdicts.label: an analysis made before the stamp existed
an analysis made before the stamp existed, of a run that was paused and continued

expected.sentence: This analysis does not record which of run R's records it read, and the run was paused and continued, so it may predate the continuation. Re-analyze the run to be sure its effects cover every record.
